analysis.summary: Sonam Limited reported a significant increase in financial performance for the first half of FY27, with revenue reaching Rs. 195 crores and profit after tax growing to Rs. 6.75 crores. Management highlighted that growth is driven primarily by domestic markets, premium range wall clock launches, and increased trading activities in raw materials such as ABS and polycarbonate, despite headwinds from higher export freight costs. guidance.claim: The company hopes revenue will be around Rs. 300 crore to Rs. 350 crore for this financial year.
guidance.quote: According to us revenue is around Rs. 300 crore to Rs. 350 crore. We hope it should be that.

guidance.claim: The company's target and projection is to achieve a PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore and an EPS of Rs. 5 to Rs. 6 by 2028-2029.
guidance.quote: Our plan is to provide maximum benefit to shareholders till 2028, 2029 and do PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore. And our EPS becomes Rs. 5 to Rs. 6.

guidance.claim: Management stated profit will grow by 40% to 50% in any way.
guidance.quote: But our profit will grow by 40%, 50% in any way.

guidance.claim: Management stated that full-year guidance will be 25% to 30% growth.
guidance.quote: you have given the guidance that full-year guidance will be 25% to 30% growth.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue for the next quarter to be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.
guidance.quote: For the next quarter we hope that revenue will be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth is coming more from the domestic market.
demand_outlook.quote: Actually, our growth is coming more from domestic.

demand_outlook.claim: The purchase power of people in tier-two and tier-three cities has increased, prompting a focus on premium customers.
demand_outlook.quote: So our focus now is that even in the tier two, tier three-city, very good clocks are sold. And the purchase power of those people is also increased. So our focus is now more on premium customers.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the 1st Quarter reflected deadly demand across the product portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: The 1st Quarter of FY’27 has been an increasing start to the financial year, reflecting strong operational performance, deadly demand across our product portfolio and our continuing commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted there is a little bit of impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.
demand_outlook.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

margins_costs.claim: During half-year FY27, EBITDA margin stood at 6.7% compared to 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA margin stood at 6.7% compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin improved to 3.3% from 3.18%, representing an improvement of 0.25% points.
margins_costs.quote: Our PAT margin also improved to 3.3% from 3.18%, representing an improvement of 0.25% points.

margins_costs.claim: Imported goods have an average operating margin of 3% to 4%, while manufacturing and trading activities have a 21% gross profit.
margins_costs.quote: Actually, in imported goods, we have an average margin of 3% to 4% and the average margin in trading activity and in manufacturing activity, there is 21% gross profit.

margins_costs.claim: Freight cost in other expenses constitutes 30% to 40%.
The EBITDA margin stood at 6.07% in H1 FY27 compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA margin stood at 6.07%, compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49%, reflecting our continued focus on operation efficiency, disciplined cost management and sustainable profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing.
margins_costs.quote: Margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing. So, the margin is fluctuating a bit.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for now is at 52%.
orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization for now is 52%.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that capacity utilization is 60% to 70%.

capital_allocation.claim: Dividend paid including corporate dividend tax was 120.10 lakhs for the period ended 30-09-2026.
Management confirmed there are no requirements for additional borrowing for now.

risks_headwinds.claim: Freight costs increased in exports, resulting in lower export volumes and impacting margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually this year freight cost has increased in export. So, according to that export is a little less. There is an effect on export.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material prices increased in the market.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually, the raw material prices got increased in the market but we focused more on the business and by giving special schemes and special discount we grew the business.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted a little bit impact on export as exports are going down due to the increase in price.
risks_headwinds.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

management_commitments.quote: And we have launched a lot of new models in these two months. And in the coming two, three months we will launch eight to ten new models.
